title: Rename Compose Server to Compose Hub
description: Rename the compose server technology/module to compose hub across the compose/ codebase. The hub directory already exists (Cargo.toml, bin.rs, compose.yml, k8s.yaml); the old compose/server directory is empty. Update all references (paths, identifiers, comments, configs) in compose/ to use "hub" instead of "server" where they refer to the compose server subsystem. Do not touch repo/ (different technology). Remove the stale empty compose/server directory at the end.
summary: Renamed the compose server subsystem to compose hub across the compose/ technology. Cargo package & binary renamed from "compose-session" to "compose-hub" (compose/hub/Cargo.toml). Compose (compose/hub/compose.yml): service key session→hub, working_dir /workspace/compose/server→/workspace/compose/hub, DB name compose_session→compose_hub, RUST_LOG filter compose_session→compose_hub, region 🔖Session→🔖Hub. K8s (compose/hub/k8s.yaml): namespace, all metadata names, selectors, labels, image, env and log filters renamed session/compose-session→hub/compose-hub; SessionService/SessionDeployment regions renamed to HubService/HubDeployment; ingress backend session→hub. bin.rs (compose/hub/bin.rs): admin summary comment, startup log tag, default EnvFilter and default DATABASE_URL all compose_session/compose-session→compose_hub/compose-hub. .vscode/launch.json: launcher name 🛠️dev🏘️compose📚server→🛠️dev🏘️compose📚hub and `cargo run -p compose-session`→`cargo run -p compose-hub`. User-facing strings and specs in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx, compose/engine/main.py, compose/js/index.ts, compose/desktop/renderer.tsx, compose/DOCS.md: "compose server" / "compose/server" / "compose-session" → "compose hub" / "compose/hub" / "compose-hub". Removed the now-empty compose/server directory. repo/ (different technology; COMPOSE_SERVER_* env vars and repo/server belong to the repo server) was intentionally not touched.
